Nestlé Company Profile

MARKET RESEARCHFINANCIAL ANALYSISFMCG
PROBLEM

Build a clear company profile from five years of financial and portfolio information while making the commercial story easy to interpret.

APPROACH

Analysed FY2021–2025 performance, seven product categories and three geographic zones using audited sources; decomposed organic growth into price and volume and benchmarked pricing against Unilever.

RECOMMENDATION

Use the growth decomposition and category-level margin signals to identify areas requiring closer competitive and portfolio attention.

IMPACT

Produced a 10-slide, source-validated equity and market research deck across eight primary sources.

Snabbit Tiered-Expert Concept

PRODUCT STRATEGYGROWTH
PROBLEM

Identify a customer-experience gap in scheduled bookings: customers had no quality-based choice when selecting an expert.

APPROACH

Designed an Uber-style tiered expert-matching model — Basic, Pro, Elite and Squad — and translated the idea into an interactive product concept.

RECOMMENDATION

Test the concept through a phased pilot: favourite-expert, single-city Pro, then Elite/Squad, with quality guardrails.

IMPACT

Created a pitch deck, interactive app mock-ups and a working HTML/JS prototype to demonstrate the concept end-to-end.
